title: Pi Resource Center
description: Inspect and manage the Pi Packages, Skills, Extensions, Prompt Templates, and Themes available to this project. Configuration remains compatible with Pi's native directories and settings.json.

metrics.enabled: Resolved from the effective Pi configuration

composition.title: Effective resource composition
composition.description: Counts come from Pi SettingsManager and PackageManager resolution. Files that merely exist on disk are not presented as usable resources unless Pi resolves them.

runtime.title: Resolution environment
runtime.inspectorHint: The Resource Center organizes configuration. Use Effective Pi in the main workbench to verify what a particular session actually loaded.

packages.security: A Pi Package may contain Extensions that execute local code, and Skills may instruct the Agent to run commands. Review the source and code before installing a third-party Package.
packages.empty: No Pi Package is configured in either the user or project settings.json.
packages.installDescription: Accepts npm:, Git URLs/shorthand, and local paths. Pi performs the installation and writes directly to native settings.json.
packages.updateUnchecked: Available updates have not been checked
packages.reloadDeferred: The native Pi configuration has been saved. Resource reload was deferred because an Agent is running in this project; new sessions will use the new configuration without interrupting the active run.
packages.confirmInstall: Install and enable {{source}} at {{scope}} scope. This Package may execute local code; continue only if you reviewed and trust its source.
packages.confirmUpdate: Pi will update or reconcile {{source}}. The active session will reload resources when the operation finishes.
packages.confirmRemove: Remove {{source}} from Pi settings and its managed installation directory. Resources supplied by this Package will no longer be available.
packages.noResolvedResources: Pi did not resolve any configurable resource from this Package.

themes.empty: No Theme resource was resolved by the current Pi configuration. Vizruna UI themes are independent from Pi terminal Themes.

warning.project-untrusted: Pi does not trust this project, so project settings, Packages, and executable resources are not loaded
warning.package-missing: Package is configured but not installed locally
warning.package-read-error: Package metadata could not be read
warning.resolve-error: Pi PackageManager could not finish resolving resources
